items.summary: The southern US state of Mississippi has elected its first Black senator in more than 140 years. Democrat Scott Colom has won the seat in a historic upset, according to projections.

items.summary: Democrat Scott Colom has won election to the U.S. Senate in Mississippi, according to a race call by the Associated Press, defeating Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith.

items.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins historic Senate race in Mississippi
Democrat Scott Colom wins historic Senate race in Mississippi
items.summary: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi after a final count on Wednesday, becoming the state's first Black US senator since Reconstruction. His narrow victory adds to the Democrats' midterm gains as President Donald Trump's party suffers a series of defeats.

items.title: Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate election over incumbent Republican Hyde-Smith
